title: Platform Engineering Expert - SAP's Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS)
description:
Platform Engineering Expert - SAP's Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS)

We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we’ll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what’s next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You’ll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What’s in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

PURPOSE AND OBJECTIVES

Join an innovative, collaborative development environment and help shape secure data access and connectivity capabilities as part of SAP’s Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS). We are looking for a Platform Engineering Expert to help shape the next generation of SAP Data Accelerator and related BDFS platform capabilities across architecture, engineering execution, and production readiness. We do not work as data scientists analyzing or extracting data directly. We build the platform capabilities that make this possible.

THE PRODUCT

SAP Data Accelerator focuses on secure partner connectivity and access to SAP business data across SAP ERP and LoB applications in on‑premise, private cloud, and public cloud landscapes. This work sits within the broader BDFS portfolio, which enables SAP Lines of Business and customers to enter the world of big data more easily. BDFS delivers platform capabilities such as Apache Spark as a service, multi‑language data processing on Kubernetes‑based infrastructure, and access to hyperscaler‑agnostic data sources using the Delta Sharing protocol on top of the HANA Data Lake File Service (HDLFS). As the product evolves through future phases, the scope expands from secure connectivity into broader API‑driven and platform‑managed data access capabilities.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Platform Engineering Expert, you will contribute across design, coding, testing, operability, and quality assurance in a development team, while also helping shape architecture and technical direction. You will assess and solve issues in new or existing code and work with high attention to detail, reliability, and efficiency. You will collaborate closely with your team members and stakeholders to ensure success.

In your day‑to‑day, your tasks will be:

  • Work on design, coding, and quality assurance tasks related to strategic product capabilities.
  • Drive platform decisions that balance security, scalability, operability, and product evolution across current and future phases.
  • Development activities in Java, Python, and Go, with Rust as a plus.
  • Work in an agile team that uses the Scrum framework to self‑organize and work towards development goals.
  • Mentor and guide the team to foster professional development and engineering excellence.
  • Support the team on technical discussions, architecture topics, and platform direction.
  • Help build PoCs, evaluate technical options, and drive important engineering decisions.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required skills

Core engineering and technical leadership

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering.
  • Advanced or fluent English.
  • Excellent programming skills and knowledge of algorithms, data structures, space, and run‑time complexity (Big‑O notation).
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in Java, Python, and/or Go in cloud‑native and Kubernetes‑based environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex software issues leveraging technical and product skills.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Willingness to continuously learn both new technologies and business processes.

Platform, security, and operability

  • Strong expertise in networking concepts relevant to distributed systems, secure partner connectivity, and cloud environments.
  • Strong command of secure connectivity and platform engineering patterns, including OAuth 2.0, mTLS, multi‑tenant service design, and proxy or tunnel‑based architectures.
  • Strong background in production hardening, SRE practices, observability, and scalable multi‑tenant service operation.
  • Experience with observability practices including metrics, tracing, health checks, alerting, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience with scalability, autoscaling, capacity management, and performance tuning for distributed services.
  • Experience with secure software engineering, threat modeling, and automated testing across unit, integration, end‑to‑end, and scale scenarios.
  • Knowledge of AI‑assisted and agentic engineering tools, and the ability to use them effectively across the software development lifecycle.

SAP and platform architecture

  • Strong expertise in SAP backend integration, including SAP ERP (ECC or S/4HANA), the NetWeaver stack, and related extensibility patterns.
  • Experience shaping technical direction for secure partner connectivity and SAP data access scenarios.
  • Experience designing API‑driven platform capabilities such as self‑service enrollment, endpoint discovery, connection and session management, capacity management, or related control‑plane workflows.
  • Experience shaping control‑plane and data‑plane architectures for secure, scalable enterprise data access.
  • Willingness to take ownership, drive new developments, and work creatively on challenging and groundbreaking tasks in accordance with the highest technical standards, plus a high level of commitment, team spirit, flexibility, and initiative.

Nice to have

  • Rust development experience.
  • Hands‑on ABAP development experience.
  • Experience building SAP add‑ons or backend extensions.
  • Current hands‑on experience using AI‑assisted or agentic tools across the software development lifecycle.

LEARNING OPPORTUNITIES

  • By joining our team, you will help shape platform capabilities that evolve from current connectivity scenarios toward broader API‑driven and storage‑backed data access scenarios.
  • You will work on high‑impact engineering topics spanning platform architecture, security, scale, observability, and operational excellence.
  • You will collaborate with strong engineers across BDFS and adjacent SAP platform areas.
  • You will influence how secure enterprise data access capabilities are built for hybrid SAP landscapes over the next project phases.

You will work with your team on SAP Data Accelerator within SAP HANA Cloud & Datalakehouse / Big Data Fabric Services. These products help our customers access data from anywhere.

The Big Data Fabric Services team is responsible for:

  • Extend and complete the SAP Data Platform with big data technologies to support different SAP Lines of Business.
  • Leverage Apache Spark and object store technology to provide scalable and cost‑effective computing and storage services for big data ingestion, processing, and sharing.
  • Integrate into SAP BTP and HANA Cloud & Data Lakehouse to offer a unified development and deployment experience for different SAP Lines of Business.
  • Assure multi‑tenancy and secure data processing.
  • Build capabilities for secure partner connectivity and governed access to SAP business data.

In the BDFS team, we have an agile and collaborative culture where knowledge sharing is fostered.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, etc.), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

title: DevOps & Security Engineer
description:
We’re building Reflow, a workforce and workflow intelligence platform that helps teams understand and improve how work gets done. As adoption scales, our infrastructure needs to be more secure, observable, and cost‑efficient. We’re looking for a DevOps & Security Engineer to help us evolve our cloud setup, strengthen security posture, and ensure Reflow runs fast, safely, and reliably at scale.

What you’ll do

  • Own infrastructure deployment, monitoring, and scaling across AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes), and automated deployment flows.
  • Design isolated multi-tenant environments for enterprise customers.
  • Implement and manage infrastructure monitoring, alerting, and performance dashboards.
  • Lead initiatives in data protection, encryption, and threat detection.
  • Manage infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) to ensure reproducibility and version control.
  • Partner with engineering to plan and execute a migration toward a more efficient, secure cloud architecture.
  • Support ongoing security reviews, compliance efforts, and audits.

Who you are

  • Experienced in cloud infrastructure management (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong background in CI/CD, container orchestration, and automated scaling.
  • Deep understanding of infrastructure security, including encryption, access control, and monitoring.
  • Comfortable balancing performance, cost, and reliability when designing systems.
  • Detail‑oriented, proactive, and unafraid to make tough calls when it comes to reliability and safety.

Bonus points

  • Experience with Heroku, Cloudflare, or Vercel environments.
  • Background in security compliance frameworks and audit preparation.
  • Familiarity with performance tuning for multi‑tenant SaaS systems.

Why join

You’ll own the backbone of Reflow’s reliability and trust, ensuring the systems that power our intelligence platform are secure, scalable, and efficient. You’ll work directly with founders and engineers, improving deployment speed, observability, and resilience. This role is perfect for someone who loves systems thinking and wants meaningful influence over infrastructure evolution.

Compensation

We offer competitive pay based on the market and where you’re located. The salary ranges in our job postings are intentionally wide because they need to cover both U.S. and international candidates. Our final offer will depend on things like your experience, skill set, and location.

Position Summary

SOBRE A SAMSUNG E O SRBR. É missão da Samsung inspirar o mundo e moldar o futuro com ideias e tecnologias transformadoras! E você sabia que muitas dessas inovações são pensadas e desenvolvidas por talentos brasileiros e impactam a vida de milhões de pessoas pelo mundo? Nosso Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento - o SRBR - conta com duas unidades no Brasil, em Campinas/SP e em Manaus/AM, com atuação nas áreas de Inteligência Artificial, Segurança da Informação, Ciência de Dados, Desenvolvimento de Software e Automação, e é referência em tecnologias aplicadas à saúde e bem‑estar. Aqui no SRBR respiramos inovação! Trabalhar em um P&D é estar sempre à frente, olhando para o futuro. Por aqui, profissionais da tecnologia e da área da saúde trabalham, pesquisam e criam soluções juntos, com muita sinergia e colaboração, em um ecossistema disruptivo que inclui universidades, institutos de pesquisa e acadêmicos. Nosso DNA é de pura inovação e criatividade, sem perder nossa essência de empresa sólida, consistente e em pleno crescimento. Nosso jeito de trabalhar está em constante evolução, acreditamos na potência do trabalho presencial para a sinergia entre as equipes.

Role And Responsibilities

Responsável por pesquisa e desenvolvimento de tecnologias de aprendizado de máquina, com foco específico em Self‑Supervised Learning (SSL), no contexto de saúde e bem‑estar, aplicado a dispositivos vestíveis e todo o ecossistema Samsung. O especialista atuará na criação de frameworks e modelos que permitem o aprendizado eficiente de representações a partir de dados não rotulados, contribuindo para o avanço de soluções inovadoras em inteligência artificial.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Participar de projetos de P&D de Inteligência Artificial (IA) do SRBR, que têm o objetivo de produzir tecnologia inovadora para equipar os dispositivos Samsung e possibilitar novos serviços.
  • Desenvolver e otimizar frameworks de SSL para extrair representações de dados não rotulados, aplicáveis a séries temporais, assim como dados tabulares.
  • Definir e executar experimentos de SSL, avaliando métricas de desempenho e comparando resultados com abordagens supervisionadas e semi-supervisionadas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares (STEM, ciências biológicas, e ciências médicas) para integrar soluções de SSL em projetos de IA.
  • Contribuir para a formulação da estratégia da equipe, propondo projetos inovadores.
  • Acompanhar e reportar o progresso dos projetos, garantindo a entrega de resultados alinhados com os objetivos técnicos e comerciais.
  • Mentoria e desenvolvimento técnico de pares, compartilhando conhecimentos avançados em SSL e aprendizado de máquina.

REQUISITOS

  • Bacharel em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas.
  • Mestrado ou Doutorado em Ciência da Computação, Estatística, Matemática, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas correlatas, ou experiência similar compatível na indústria.
  • Experiência na indústria com construção de modelos de aprendizado de máquina com SSL (desejável).
  • Inglês oral e escrito avançado.

Competências Técnicas

  • Proficiência em Self‑Supervised Learning, incluindo experiência com Contrastive Learning e/ou Self‑Distillation, assim como métodos baseados em reconstrução e agrupamento.
  • Experiência em design e implementação de modelos de aprendizado profundo para extração de representações.
  • Conhecimento avançado em probabilidade, estatística e projeto de experimentos.
  • Habilidade em programação, principalmente proficiência em Python e PyTorch.
  • Capacidade de treinar modelos em grandes volumes de informação, utilizando técnicas de aprendizado distribuído e otimização de recursos computacionais.
  • Experiência em otimização de modelos para dispositivos com restrição de recursos.
  • Experiência com ambientes de big data e processamento distribuído.
  • Publicação acadêmica e participação em conferências sobre aprendizado de máquina e IA.

DIVERSIDADE, INCLUSÃO E EQUIDADE

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
At PPRO, our mission is to simplify access to local payment methods and our vision is to enable the sale of goods and services to anyone in the world using their preferred way to pay. We empower partners such as Ant Group, PayPal and Stripe to access new markets, connect with more customers, and accelerate their growth.

Our strength lies in our diverse global team with 50+ nationalities and 10+ international locations – all united around one goal: to deliver the best possible products and services to our partners and customers.

The Purpose:

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer in PPRO's Performance Powerhouse team, you will define the technical vision and architecture for ML‑driven payment optimization across the organization. You will move beyond executing well‑defined problems to identifying and framing the highest‑leverage opportunities—bridging strategy, architecture, and execution across multiple teams. You'll partner deeply with Product, Data, Core Payments, and Platform Engineering to set standards, eliminate systemic bottlenecks, and ensure PPRO's ML capabilities scale with the business.

This role is for engineers who have mastered ML and software craft at the senior level and are now ready to multiply their impact through technical leadership, mentorship of senior engineers, and architectural decisions that shape how the Data & ML organization builds and deploys ML systems. You will be the technical authority on ML for payments at PPRO—setting the direction others follow, raising the bar across the discipline, and driving alignment across engineering, product, and data teams.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Define ML Technical Strategy: Drive the multi‑quarter roadmap for ML‑driven authorization optimization, routing intelligence, and retry strategies. Identify the highest‑impact opportunities before they become obvious, and build the case for investment with data and business framing.
  • Architect Foundational ML Systems: Design and lead the implementation of shared ML infrastructure – feature stores, model serving platforms, experimentation frameworks that accelerate every team building on payments data, not just your own.
  • Drive Cross‑Team Technical Standards: Author and champion ML engineering standards across PPRO (model governance, monitoring, MLOps patterns), ensuring consistency, reliability, and reproducibility organization‑wide.
  • Solve Ambiguous, High‑Stakes Problems: Take on challenges where the problem itself isn't well‑defined. You scope, structure, and sequence the work – then lead execution across multiple engineers and teams to deliver.
  • Mentor and Level Up Senior Engineers: Actively invest in the growth of Senior engineers through design reviews, pairing on hard problems, sponsoring stretch opportunities, and raising expectations for what "production‑ready ML" means at PPRO.
  • Lead Experimentation at Scale: Design the experimentation strategy for live payment traffic—including multi‑armed bandits, causal inference approaches, and traffic‑splitting frameworks—ensuring sound statistical methodology across the team.
  • Elevate Engineering Culture: Run design reviews, set expectations for technical documentation, and create the internal forums (guilds, working groups, RFCs) that help ML practitioners across teams learn from each other and align on standards.

What We Are Looking For

  • ML Architecture at Scale: Demonstrated experience designing and shipping ML systems that serve multiple products or teams—not just models, but the platforms, contracts, and abstractions that make ML reusable and reliable at scale.
  • Technical Leadership Without Authority: Proven ability to drive technical decisions across teams you don't manage—through clear writing, credibility, and the ability to synthesize competing perspectives into a coherent path forward.
  • Deep Classical & Applied ML Mastery: Expert‑level command of classical ML (XGBoost, LightGBM, calibration, cost‑sensitive learning) with the judgment to know when—and when not—to reach for more complex approaches. You've operated beyond standard accuracy metrics and can design evaluation frameworks appropriate to the problem.
  • Production ML Engineering: Extensive experience taking models from experimentation to high‑throughput, low‑latency production environments. You've owned reliability, SLAs, and incident response for ML systems, and you've built MLOps tooling—not just consumed it.
  • Software Engineering Excellence: You write and review code at a senior+ level in Python, hold the team to high standards for testability and maintainability, and can credibly engage in systems design discussions with Principal and Staff engineers across Data and Platform.
  • Strategic Thinking & Business Acumen: You connect technical decisions to business outcomes—approval rate improvements to revenue, latency reductions to conversion, model drift to operational risk. You communicate clearly with non‑technical stakeholders and can translate ambiguous business goals into concrete ML problems.
  • Payments Domain Depth: Strong understanding of the card payment lifecycle, issuer behavior, authorization codes, retry logic, network rules, and 3DS. You use domain knowledge to inform feature design, model architecture, and experimentation strategy—not just as background context.
  • Cloud Infrastructure Mastery: Deep experience designing and owning ML infrastructure on AWS or GCP at scale, including infrastructure‑as‑code, cost management, and the ability to make build‑vs‑buy decisions on platform components.

What we offer:

  • Hybrid working – We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30‑day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
  • Learning and Development – We offer a 3,000 BRL annual budget to support your professional growth. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on‑the‑job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
  • Insurance – Because better safe than sorry, we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including life insurance, health insurance, dental plan and travel insurance.
  • Meal vouchers – BRL 54 / day – Enjoy a moment of conviviality and a good and balanced meal thanks to your meal vouchers. You will also have the choice between meal allowance, supermarket voucher or both (splitting the total value in two).
  • Enhance Family Leave – We understand the importance of family – that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
  • Transportation Voucher – We will cover your costs of commute.
  • Gym membership – PPRO helps contribute toward the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet.
  • New Value (Deals & Coupon Platform) – Get attractive discounts to restaurants, stores and events.
  • Mental Health Platform – We’ve teamed up with a top well‑being platform to provide one‑on‑one therapy, chat therapy, therapist‑led courses, guided meditations, and more.
  • SESC – private institution that makes available Education, Health, Culture and Recreational programs and events and provides Social Assistance to our employees and their dependents.
  • Pet‑friendly office – Because work is better with your paw‑tners by your side.

title: CHARGÉ DE COMMUNICATION 360° H/F
description:
Convention collective : Horlogerie, boujouterie, joaillerie, orfèvrerie

Rémunération : A définir

Fondée en 864, la Monnaie de Paris est à la fois la plus ancienne des institutions françaises et la plus ancienne entreprise du monde.
Etablissement public à caractère industriel et commercial (EPIC) depuis le 1er janvier 2007 et rattaché au Ministère de l’Economie et des Finances, notre mission depuis 12 siècles consiste à frapper la monnaie des français, et depuis le XIXème siècle, celles d’autres pays du monde (environ 40 aujourd’hui). La Monnaie de Paris est composée d'environ 500 collaborateurs.
Depuis 1973, notre activité est répartie sur deux sites :

  • Le site historique du Quai de Conti à Paris, où sont réalisées les productions d’art (monnaies de collection en métaux précieux, médailles, décorations officielles, fontes d’art et bijoux) mais également où est assurée la conservation, la protection et la présentation au public de nos collections historiques au travers du Musée de la Monnaie de Paris.
  • L’usine de Pessac en Gironde, où sont fabriquées les pièces d’euro pour la France, les monnaies des pays étrangers mais aussi les monnaies de collections et les jetons touristiques.
    Les activités commerciales exercées dans le secteur concurrentiel représentent dorénavant 70% de nos revenus.

Enfin, au sein de notre Institution, le sentiment d’appartenance est un vecteur important de notre dynamique. C’est pourquoi la Monnaie de Paris s’engage à promouvoir les talents internes afin de leur offrir les meilleures opportunités d’évolution et à rechercher de nouveaux talents externes pour répondre aux exigences d'aujourd’hui et aux défis de demain.

Mission générale

Vous êtes rattaché à la Responsable Communication digitale et produits au sein dela Direction du marketing et de la communication et êtes responsable de la mise en œuvre des projets de communication 360° visant à promouvoir la nouvelle offre de métal‑investissement, lancée par la Monnaie de Paris en juin 2026.

Détail du poste

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec plusieurs directions de la Monnaie de Paris, telles que la direction commerciale, la direction de la stratégie et la direction des systèmes d’information.
Vos responsabilités vous conduisent à gérer des projets de communication impliquant divers interlocuteurs et experts internes (responsable commercial, économiste, juriste, responsable de projets SI…) et externes (agences, partenaires…).

Responsabilités

  • Piloter et suivre le déploiement du plan de communication 360° de la nouvelle gamme de produits :
    • vous assurez la pertinence et la cohérence du plan de communication, en lien avec votre hiérarchie ;
    • vous contribuez au bon déploiement du plan de communication post‑lancement de l’offre, en coordonnant les actions et en suivant leur performance.
  • Participer à l’élaboration d’un plan de communication fil rouge, ainsi que des plans de communication des années 2 et 3 (post‑lancement), en définissant les axes stratégiques, les outils et les dispositifs nécessaires pour répondre aux objectifs de notoriété, d’image et de développement commercial.
  • Coordonner les parties prenantes internes et externes : vous assurez la cohérence des messages entre les équipes internes et les partenaires externes (agences de communication, agences médias, etc.).
  • Assurer la gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets de communication produit, avec un focus principal sur le suivi de la nouvelle gamme : vous pilotez les projets de bout en bout, dans le respect des plannings et des budgets, et veillez à la qualité et à la cohérence des messages avec la stratégie de marque.

Missions principales :

  • Vous déployez et pilotez le plan de communication 360° : vous supervisez la mise en œuvre des projets offline, online et social media, suivez l’avancement des actions et garantissez le respect des délais.
  • Vous assurez le suivi de la performance des actions : vous définissez et analysez les indicateurs de performance (KPI), consolidez les résultats et formulez des recommandations d’optimisation.
  • Vous préparez et contribuez activement aux instances de pilotage internes (comités, copil…) ainsi qu’aux échanges avec les prestataires et agences.
  • Vous restituez les résultats : vous collaborez avec les équipes communication, marketing et commerciales pour préparer des bilans, présenter les résultats et partager les enseignements à l’ensemble de l’organisation.

Profil, Expérience, Formation

Diplômé(e) d’un Bac +4/5 en communication, vous justifiez d’une expérience professionnelle réussie d’au moins 5 ans sur un poste similaire.

Compétences / Savoir-faire :

  • Vous maîtrisez les principes de la communication stratégique et de la communication 360° (médias et hors médias), ainsi que les points de contact avec le client final (site web, brochures, emailing, vidéo, etc.).
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils de communication et possédez une bonne connaissance des médias traditionnels (presse, TV, radio) et digitaux (réseaux sociaux, blogs, sites web), ainsi que des outils graphiques et multimédia.
  • Vous savez suivre et évaluer l’impact des actions de communication.
  • Vous disposez de solides compétences en gestion de projet (maîtrise des plannings, des délais et des ressources).
  • Vous faites preuve d’une forte capacité à coordonner des équipes internes et externes (agences, prestataires, etc.).
  • Vous êtes capable de travailler sur plusieurs projets simultanément et de prioriser efficacement les tâches.
  • Vous possédez d’excellentes compétences rédactionnelles et savez adapter vos contenus à différents supports.
  • Vous êtes en capacité de suivre et d’analyser les résultats des actions de communication : compréhension et suivi des indicateurs clés (KPI), participation à la création de reportings et contribution aux bilans et recommandations.

Savoir-être :

  • Vous avez un fort esprit d’équipe et le sens du travail collaboratif.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils collaboratifs et de gestion de projet.
  • Vous faites preuve d’un excellent sens de l’organisation et d’une grande rigueur dans la gestion des priorités et des délais.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise à l’oral et savez communiquer efficacement en réunion ou en présentation.
  • Vous manifestez une forte appétence pour le secteur bancaire, financier et de l’investissement, avec une bonne compréhension de ses enjeux et de ses tendances.
  • Vous possédez une connaissance approfondie des spécificités du secteur financier et des produits bancaires et d’investissement, vous permettant de concevoir des messages percutants et adaptés aux attentes des clients et investisseurs.

Venir à la Monnaie de Paris, c’est rejoindre une institution engagée dans la diversité et l’inclusion, un bel environnement de travail, dynamique et stimulant…

Nous vous proposons :

  • Tickets restaurant d'une valeur de 11.50€ pris en charge à hauteur de 60%
  • Pass Navigo, pris en charge à hauteur de 75%
  • Accès aux avantages du CSE de la Monnaie de Paris à partir de 3 mois d’ancienneté

Job Description

A globally recognized developer and manufacturer of specialty immunoassay diagnostic solutions is seeking a dynamic Country Manager to lead and expand its presence in Brazil. The organization is known for its strong portfolio of ELISA assays, with particular differentiation in specialty biomarkers, and niche diagnostic testing areas underserved by large automated platform providers. The position reports to the Global Chief Commercial Officer. This leader will be responsible for establishing and scaling the company’s legal entity and commercial footprint in Brazil, driving profitable growth through a hybrid model of distributor management and direct market engagement. The role requires a strategic and hands‑on executive who can navigate Brazil’s complex healthcare ecosystem, build high‑value clinical relationships, and position a specialized diagnostic portfolio within mid‑size laboratories, reference labs, and targeted hospital segments. The ideal candidate is a builder and strategist who understands how to scale a specialty diagnostics business in a complex, distributor‑driven market. This individual combines hands‑on sales leadership with strategic vision and can effectively position a differentiated immunoassay portfolio against both niche competitors and large automated platform players.

Key Responsibilities

  • Market Entry & Entity Leadership
    • Lead the setup, registration, and compliant operation of the Brazilian legal entity.
    • Define and execute the go‑to‑market model (distributor‑led, hybrid, or direct sales evolution).
    • Ensure alignment with regulatory, tax, and healthcare compliance requirements in Brazil.
    • Serve as the primary in‑country executive, representing the company with stakeholders, partners, and authorities.
  • Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth
    • Own full P&L responsibility, including revenue growth, operating income, and cost management.
    • Develop and execute a country‑specific commercial strategy aligned with regional and global objectives.
    • Drive adoption of specialty immunoassay products.
    • Identify and capture opportunities in mid‑volume labs, reference labs, and specialty testing centers.
    • Lead tender processes, pricing strategy, and contract negotiations.
  • Distributor & Channel Management
    • Select, develop, and manage high‑performing distributor partners.
    • Establish clear performance metrics, training programs, and accountability structures.
    • Optimize channel strategy to balance market coverage, margin, and control.
    • Continuously assess opportunities to transition key segments toward direct sales or hybrid models.
  • Business Development & Key Account Leadership
    • Actively engage in customer acquisition and relationship management, particularly with key opinion leaders, reference laboratories, and strategic hospital accounts.
    • Build long‑term partnerships that support menu expansion and recurring reagent revenue.
    • Position the company as a specialty diagnostics partner rather than a commodity supplier.
  • Organizational Build‑Out
    • Define and implement the optimal organizational structure to support growth.
    • Recruit, develop, and lead commercial and support teams as the business scales.
    • Establish a performance‑driven culture with strong accountability and collaboration.
  • Financial Planning & Operational Excellence
    • Develop and manage the annual operating plan and long‑range plan.
    • Ensure accurate sales forecasting, pipeline management, and reporting.
    • Optimize working capital, inventory, and cost structures.
    • Monitor KPIs including revenue growth, margins, and market share.
  • Market Intelligence & Strategic Positioning
    • Track market trends, competitive dynamics, and technology shifts (e.g., automation vs. ELISA).
    • Identify opportunities to strengthen positioning in underserved niche biomarkers and flexible, non‑automated testing environments.
    • Provide strategic input to regional leadership on portfolio expansion and localization needs.
  • Regional & Global Collaboration
    • Partner closely with Latin America leadership, global commercial teams, and headquarters.
    • Contribute to regional strategy development and best practice sharing.
    • Ensure alignment with global branding, regulatory, and operational standards.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
    • Business, Life Sciences, or related field.
  • Experience
    • Minimum 10–15 years of leadership experience in diagnostics, medical devices, or life sciences.
    • Proven success in general management, sales leadership, or country management roles.
    • Strong experience in Brazil’s healthcare and diagnostics market.
    • Demonstrated success managing distributors and/or hybrid commercial models.
    • Experience with tender‑driven sales environments and complex procurement processes.
  • Industry Expertise
    • Strong understanding of clinical diagnostics workflows.
    • Laboratory purchasing and decision‑making processes.
    • Immunoassay technologies (ELISA preferred).
    • Familiarity with specialty testing markets vs. high‑throughput automation segments.
  • Leadership Competencies
    • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to build from the ground up.
    • Strong commercial acumen and financial literacy.
    • Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, international organization.
    • Skilled in influencing without authority across distributor networks and internal stakeholders.
  • Language Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a builder and strategist who understands how to scale a specialty diagnostics business in a complex, distributor‑driven market. This individual combines hands‑on sales leadership with strategic vision and can effectively position a differentiated immunoassay portfolio against both niche competitors and large automated platform players.

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Estamos em busca de um(a) Power BI Backend Developer apaixonado(a) por dados, arquitetura e performance, para atuar na sustentação e evolução das fundações que suportam todo o ecossistema de Business Intelligence da organização.

Principais Responsabilidades

Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento Backend

  • Projetar, desenvolver e otimizar modelos de dados no Power BI, garantindo relacionamentos eficientes, granularidade adequada, particionamento e estruturas escaláveis.

DAX Avançado e Lógica de Negócio

  • Desenvolver medidas DAX complexas para cálculos avançados, análises temporais (Time Intelligence), regras de negócio dinâmicas e indicadores corporativos.
  • Implementar lógicas de filtragem avançadas e cálculos multiníveis.
  • Diagnosticar e corrigir inconsistências relacionadas a contexto de avaliação, relacionamentos ambíguos e modelagens inadequadas.
  • Garantir escalabilidade e performance das regras de negócio implementadas.

Performance e Otimização

  • Realizar análises aprofundadas de performance em modelos e datasets.
  • Otimizar consultas, medidas DAX e estratégias de Calculation Groups.
  • Avaliar Query Folding e identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de transformação.
  • Reduzir tamanho dos modelos por meio da otimização de tabelas e estruturas de dados.
  • Utilizar ferramentas como Performance Analyzer para investigar gargalos e melhorar a experiência dos usuários.

Integração de Dados e ETL

  • Trabalhar em parceria com as equipes de Engenharia de Dados para definir estruturas de dados adequadas antes da ingestão no Power BI.

  • Validar pipelines de atualização, conexões, credenciais e estratégias de Incremental Refresh.
  • Garantir estabilidade e eficiência nos fluxos de ingestão e transformação de dados.

Governança, Segurança e Qualidade dos Dados

  • Gerenciar permissões e acessos em workspaces e datasets.
  • Garantir a confiabilidade dos dados, sucesso das atualizações e conformidade com padrões de qualidade.
  • Monitorar uso dos ambientes, capacidade, armazenamento, custos de processamento e saúde geral dos datasets.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de governança de dados e padronização das soluções analíticas.

Suporte Técnico e Resolução de Problemas

  • Investigar e solucionar incidentes relacionados a:
    • Erros de DAX e regras de negócio
    • Falhas de atualização e problemas de gateway
    • Inconsistências de qualidade dos dados
    • Impactos nos relatórios gerados por lógicas de backend
  • Fornecer suporte técnico às equipes na interpretação de estruturas de dados, métricas e KPIs.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para temas relacionados à arquitetura e modelagem de dados no Power BI.

O que buscamos

Hard Skills

  • Experiência sólida com Power BI Desktop e Power BI Service, especialmente na gestão de datasets corporativos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em DAX, modelagem de dados, análise de performance e otimização de consultas.
  • Forte experiência em modelagem dimensional, incluindo:
    • Star Schema

    • Chaves substitutas (Surrogate Keys)

  • Conhecimento consistente em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais.

  • Conhecimento sobre governança, segurança e melhores práticas de arquitetura de BI.

Soft Skills

  • Perfil altamente analítico e estruturado para resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de comunicar conceitos técnicos de forma clara para diferentes públicos.
  • Habilidade para atuar em colaboração com engenheiros de dados, arquitetos, analistas e stakeholders de negócio.
  • Senso de dono, proatividade e foco em resultados.
  • Atenção aos detalhes e compromisso com qualidade e confiabilidade das informações.
  • Mentalidade de melhoria contínua e busca constante por excelência técnica.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Platform ou ambientes analíticos em nuvem.
  • Conhecimento em Tabular Editor, DAX Studio e ferramentas de monitoramento de performance.
  • Vivência em projetos de governança e arquitetura corporativa de BI.
  • Certificações Microsoft relacionadas a Power BI, Data Analytics ou Data Engineering.
  • Experiência com CI/CD para soluções analíticas.

Resumo da Posição

Esta posição é ideal para profissionais que desejam atuar profundamente nos pilares técnicos do Power BI, sendo responsáveis pela modelagem de dados, arquitetura, performance, governança e confiabilidade das soluções analíticas. description:
Role Purpose

The Cloud Security Engineer demonstrates a high level of professionalism, leveraging in-depth knowledge in cloud security and a basic understanding of related cybersecurity disciplines to adapt departmental plans and recommend optimal solutions and best practices within the Cyber Security Engineering & Automation department. This individual contributor role manages cloud security projects and processes independently with limited supervision, allowing for tactical choices within established functional policies and broad procedures to achieve security goals. They are responsible for the execution of main cloud security activities to achieve important security outcomes, actively participating in small to medium-sized projects of moderate complexity and contributing to process improvements. The Engineer performs a variety of complex tasks, requiring detailed analysis to understand problems and supporting the delivery of solutions to intricate cloud security challenges where clear precedents may not exist.

Main Accountabilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls across cloud platforms (IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS).
  • Define and enforce cloud security standards, guardrails, and reference architectures.
  • Secure cloud networking, identity, access management, and data protection services.
  • Implement and manage cloud security tooling such as CSPM, CWPP, CIEM, and WAF solutions.
  • Partner with cloud engineering and application teams to embed security into CI/CD and IaC pipelines (DevSecOps).
  • Conduct cloud security risk assessments, architecture reviews, and threat modeling.
  • Monitor cloud environments for misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and security events, coordinating response with global SOC and IR teams.
  • Support regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements and global security standards.
  • Provide regional cloud security expertise and support global cloud security initiatives.

Knowledge & Skills

  • In-depth knowledge of cloud security principles, architectures, and best practices across major cloud providers (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Experience with cloud security tools and technologies (e.g., CASB, CSPM, CIEM, WAF).
  • Proficiency in scripting/automation for cloud environments (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Strong understanding of network security, identity and access management, data protection, and compliance in cloud contexts.
  • Ability to perform complex analysis and support the delivery of solutions to intricate cloud security problems.
  • Excellent communication skills, capable of providing leadership and guidance to technical teams and stakeholders.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering with strong focus on cloud security.
  • Hands‑on experience securing major cloud platforms (GCP, Azure, and/or AWS).
  • Strong knowledge of cloud identity, networking, encryption, logging, and monitoring services.
  • Experience with infrastructure‑as‑code (Terraform, ARM, Cloud Deployment Manager, or similar).
  • Understanding of cloud threat models and security frameworks (NIST, CSA, MITRE).

Position Overview

As a Technical Talent Acquisition Specialist, you will lead and optimize the recruitment of senior and mid-level technical professionals across software engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure teams. You will act as a trusted partner to engineering leaders, driving hiring strategies, improving recruitment processes, and ensuring Ultahost continues to attract top-tier technical talent globally.   • Own and manage the full-cycle recruitment process for senior and high-impact technical roles, including Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, and DevOps positions.

    • Programming languages: JavaScript, Python, Go
    • Front-end frameworks: Next.js, React.js, Angular
    • Back-end frameworks: Node.js, Nest.js, Express.js, Golang
    • Hosting & infrastructure: OpenLiteSpeed, NGINX, Apache, Docker, Linux, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Build and maintain a high-quality senior talent pipeline through LinkedIn, direct sourcing, referrals, and professional networks.
  • Analyze recruitment data and market trends to continuously improve hiring efficiency and quality.
  • Ensure a premium candidate experience aligned with Ultahost’s global employer brand.
  • Mentor junior recruiters (if applicable) and contribute to the improvement of internal recruitment processes and standards.
  • Stay ahead of emerging technologies, competitive landscapes, and technical hiring trends.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in technical recruitment or talent acquisition, with a strong focus on senior technical roles.
  • Proven ability to recruit for complex technical positions in software engineering, DevOps, and infrastructure.
  • Solid understanding of modern software architectures, development frameworks, and hosting technologies.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and experience partnering with senior engineering leaders.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and candidate engagement skills.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Advanced experience using ATS systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, and recruitment analytics.
  • Strategic mindset with a hands‑on approach and strong attention to detail.

title: Wholesale Credit Risk - Counterparty Credit Risk (CCR) - Analyst
description:
Job Description

Counterparty Credit Risk (CCR) team, part of Wholesale Credit Risk, is responsible for measuring counterparty exposures, conducting ad‑hoc risk investigations and analyses in partnership with credit officers, assessing and negotiating CSA terms, determining initial margin requirements, and maintaining all credit exposure metrics. The team also leads regulatory and capital stress testing exercises (CCAR, EBA, ICAAP), monitors exposures at the JPM legal entity level, evaluates collateral pools for emerging risk themes, and provides credit coverage for clearing house counterparties, including regulatory advocacy.

As an Analyst in the Counterparty Credit Risk (CCR) Methodology team, you will be instrumental in evaluating, monitoring, and mitigating counterparty credit risk exposure. This role places a strong emphasis on developing methodologies, designing stress scenarios, and addressing analytical challenges within the risk infrastructure. This position requires a proactive team player with a curious mindset, a strong analytical foundation, and expertise in programming, AI/LLM, and data visualization tools.

Job Responsibilities

  • Analyze and monitor counterparty credit risk exposures using quantitative models and risk management frameworks.
  • Design, implement, and interpret stress testing scenarios to evaluate the impact of adverse market conditions on counterparty credit risk.
  • Conduct sensitivity analysis and scenario‑based stress testing to identify potential vulnerabilities in credit portfolios.
  • Enhance CCR continuous monitoring capacity by delivering strategic tools to improve transparency, explainability, and governance of risk signals.
  • Design and implement AI/LLM‑enabled dashboard capabilities to accelerate BAU monitoring, triage, and narrative generation while maintaining appropriate controls and auditability.
  • Increase comprehensiveness and accuracy of CCR metrics by reviewing and enhancing scenario coverage, validating methodology soundness, and performing unit/product back‑testing across relevant asset classes and products.

title: Platform Engineering Expert - SAP's Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS)
description:
Purpose and Objectives

Join an innovative, collaborative development environment and help shape secure data access and connectivity capabilities as part of SAP's Big Data Fabric Services (BDFS). We are looking for a Platform Engineering Expert to help shape the next generation of SAP Data Accelerator and related BDFS platform capabilities across architecture, engineering execution, and production readiness. We do not work as data scientists analyzing or extracting data directly. We build the platform capabilities that make this possible.

The Product

SAP Data Accelerator focuses on secure partner connectivity and access to SAP business data across SAP ERP and LoB applications in on‑premise, private cloud, and public cloud landscapes. This work sits within the broader BDFS portfolio, which enables SAP Lines of Business and customers to enter the world of big data more easily. BDFS delivers platform capabilities such as Apache Spark as a service, multi‑language data processing on Kubernetes‑based infrastructure, and access to hyperscaler‑agnostic data sources using the Delta Sharing protocol on top of the HANA Data Lake File Service (HDLFS). As the product evolves through future phases, the scope expands from secure connectivity into broader API‑driven and platform‑managed data access capabilities.

What You'll Do

As a Platform Engineering Expert, you will contribute across design, coding, testing, operability, and quality assurance in a development team, while also helping shape architecture and technical direction. You will assess and solve issues in new or existing code and work with high attention to detail, reliability, and efficiency. You will collaborate closely with your team members and stakeholders to ensure success.

In Your Day‑to‑day, Your Tasks Will Be

  • Work on design, coding, and quality assurance tasks related to strategic product capabilities.
  • Drive platform decisions that balance security, scalability, operability, and product evolution across current and future phases.
  • Development activities in Java, Python, and Go, with Rust as a plus.
  • Work in an agile team that uses the Scrum framework to self‑organize and work towards development goals.
  • Mentor and guide the team to foster professional development and engineering excellence.
  • Support the team on technical discussions, architecture topics, and platform direction.
  • Help build PoCs, evaluate technical options, and drive important engineering decisions.

What You Bring

Required skills

  • Bachelor's degree in any of the following areas: Computer Science, Systems Analysis, Information Technology, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering.
  • Advanced or fluent English.
  • Excellent programming skills and knowledge of algorithms, data structures, space, and run‑time complexity (Big‑O notation).
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in Java, Python, and/or Go in cloud‑native and Kubernetes‑based environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex software issues leveraging technical and product skills.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Willingness to continuously learn both new technologies and business processes.

Platform, security, and operability

  • Strong expertise in networking concepts relevant to distributed systems, secure partner connectivity, and cloud environments.
  • Strong command of secure connectivity and platform engineering patterns, including OAuth 2.0, mTLS, multi‑tenant service design, and proxy or tunnel‑based architectures.
  • Strong background in production hardening, SRE practices, observability, and scalable multi‑tenant service operation.
  • Experience with observability practices including metrics, tracing, health checks, alerting, and OpenTelemetry.
  • Experience with scalability, autoscaling, capacity management, and performance tuning for distributed services.
  • Experience with secure software engineering, threat modeling, and automated testing across unit, integration, end‑to‑end, and scale scenarios.
  • Knowledge of AI‑assisted and agentic engineering tools, and the ability to use them effectively across the software development lifecycle.

SAP and platform architecture

  • Strong expertise in SAP backend integration, including SAP ERP (ECC or S/4HANA), the NetWeaver stack, and related extensibility patterns.
  • Experience shaping technical direction for secure partner connectivity and SAP data access scenarios.
  • Experience designing API‑driven platform capabilities such as self‑service enrollment, endpoint discovery, connection and session management, capacity management, or related control‑plane workflows.
  • Experience shaping control‑plane and data‑plane architectures for secure, scalable enterprise data access.
  • Willingness to take ownership, drive new developments, and work creatively on challenging and groundbreaking tasks in accordance with the highest technical standards, plus a high level of commitment, team spirit, flexibility, and initiative.

Nice to have

  • Rust development experience.
  • Hands‑on ABAP development experience.
  • Experience building SAP add‑ons or backend extensions.
  • Current hands‑on experience using AI‑assisted or agentic tools across the software development lifecycle.

Learning Opportunities

  • By joining our team, you will help shape platform capabilities that evolve from current connectivity scenarios toward broader API‑driven and storage‑backed data access scenarios.
  • You will work on high‑impact engineering topics spanning platform architecture, security, scale, observability, and operational excellence.
  • You will collaborate with strong engineers across BDFS and adjacent SAP platform areas.
  • You will influence how secure enterprise data access capabilities are built for hybrid SAP landscapes over the next project phases.

MEET YOUR TEAM

You will work with your team on SAP Data Accelerator within SAP HANA Cloud & Datalakehouse / Big Data Fabric Services. These products help our customers access data from anywhere.

The Big Data Fabric Services Team Is Responsible For

  • Extend and complete the SAP Data Platform with big data technologies to support different SAP Lines of Business.
  • Leverage Apache Spark and object store technology to provide scalable and cost‑effective computing and storage services for big data ingestion, processing, and sharing.
  • Integrate into SAP BTP and HANA Cloud & Data Lakehouse to offer a unified development and deployment experience for different SAP Lines of Business.
  • Assure multi‑tenancy and secure data processing.
  • Build capabilities for secure partner connectivity and governed access to SAP business data.

Este profissional monitora a qualidade dos serviços prestados, realiza a análise de feedback dos clientes e implementa ações corretivas e de melhoria contínua, visando otimizar a experiência do cliente em todas as etapas do processo pós-venda.

Objetivo do Cargo

  • Assegurar que a experiência do cliente seja elevada e de acordo com os indicadores da montadora e da concessionária.

Principais Responsabilidades:

1. Gestão da Qualidade

  • Estabelecer e acompanhar os padrões de qualidade dos serviços prestados na concessionária, garantindo que todos os processos, desde a recepção até a entrega do veículo, atendam aos requisitos de excelência.
  • Realizar auditorias periódicas nos serviços de pós-venda (oficina, lavagem, entrega de veículos) para verificar o cumprimento dos padrões estabelecidos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar procedimentos para melhoria contínua da qualidade, com foco na redução de falhas e aumento da eficiência operacional.

2. Monitoramento da Experiência do Cliente

  • Coletar e analisar feedbacks dos clientes por meio de pesquisas de satisfação, avaliações online, interações diretas e outros canais de comunicação.
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria na jornada do cliente, desde o agendamento de serviços até o pós-serviço, propondo e implementando soluções para aprimorar a experiência.
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos indicadores de satisfação e lealdade do cliente (NPS, RETENÇÃO, RECOMENDAÇÃO etc) e definir estratégias para melhorar esses índices.

3. Treinamento e Desenvolvimento da Equipe

  • Coordenar treinamentos e capacitações para as equipes de atendimento e de serviço, com foco na melhoria da experiência do cliente e no atendimento de qualidade.
  • Trabalhar junto aos líderes de equipe para garantir que todos os colaboradores compreendam a importância da qualidade no serviço e estejam alinhados com as expectativas da concessionária.
  • Fomentar uma cultura de atendimento ao cliente em toda a concessionária, garantindo que todos os colaboradores estejam engajados na entrega de uma experiência excepcional.

4. Gestão de Reclamações e Sugestões

  • Supervisionar e gerenciar o processo de tratamento de reclamações dos clientes, assegurando que todas sejam respondidas de forma eficaz e dentro do prazo estabelecido.
  • Implementar estratégias para resolver problemas de clientes insatisfeitos e transformar situações negativas em oportunidades de melhoria e fidelização.
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com as equipes envolvidas para discutir reclamações e identificar ações corretivas que possam ser aplicadas.

5. Relacionamento com Clientes e Ações de Fidelização

  • Desenvolver ações de relacionamento e fidelização de clientes, visando aumentar a satisfação e a lealdade à concessionária.
  • Planejar e executar campanhas de pós-venda para engajar os clientes, como promoções de serviços, ofertas especiais e comunicação personalizada.

  • Conhecimentos Técnicos:
    • Técnicas de gestão de qualidade e melhoria contínua (ex: Kaizen, Six Sigma, 5S, 5W2H etc).
    • Ferramentas de coleta e análise de feedback de clientes (pesquisas de satisfação, NPS, RETENÇÃO, RECOMENDAÇÃO etc).
    • Processos de atendimento e experiência do cliente.

  • Habilidades Comportamentais:
    • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade para interagir com clientes e equipes.
    • Capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes focadas no atendimento e experiência do cliente.
    • Pensamento analítico e foco em resultados.
    • Proatividade para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e implementar mudanças eficazes.
    • Empatia, paciência e habilidade para resolver conflitos e situações desafiadoras.

Indicadores relacionados:

  • Índices de satisfação do cliente, como NPS, RETENÇÃO, RECOMENDAÇÃO, entre outros, com aumento contínuo.
  • Número de reclamações resolvidas de forma satisfatória e no menor tempo possível.
  • Eficiência na implementação de ações corretivas e de melhoria com base no feedback dos clientes.
  • Engajamento e capacitação das equipes para oferecer um atendimento de alta qualidade.

A Syngenta é líder mundial em inovação agrícola, com operações em mais de 90 países. Nossas descobertas científicas pioneiras proporcionam benefícios superiores aos agricultores e à sociedade em uma escala sem precedentes. Orientados por nossas Prioridades de Sustentabilidade, desenvolvemos continuamente tecnologias e soluções que auxiliam os produtores a cultivar plantas mais saudáveis em solos revitalizados, maximizando a produtividade. Na Syngenta, nosso objetivo é construir a equipe mais colaborativa e confiável na agricultura, fornecendo sementes de alta qualidade e soluções inovadoras de proteção de cultivos que impulsionam o sucesso dos agricultores.

Será sua responsabilidade também garantir a qualidade de sementes e as entregas no prazo determinado. Sendo assim, é fundamental saber trabalhar em equipes, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho positivo e colaborativo.

Responsabilidades:

  • Executar e garantir atividades para E2E do processamento de sementes genéticas e experimentais (recebimento, secagem, beneficiamento, inventários, contagens, montagens dos kits de plantio internos e externos e armazenamento das sementes);

Dia a Dia Da Vaga

A missão do Analista de Negócios será gerar análises e insights que apoiem a gestão de produto das marcas Galápagos e INVICTUS, identificando oportunidades de desenvolvimento de produtos e coleções e transformando dados de performance, indicadores e inteligência de mercado em recomendações que subsidiem as decisões de portfólio, mix, sortimento e desenvolvimento de coleções. Contribuir para o alinhamento entre estratégia comercial, posicionamento de marca e oportunidades de mercado, fortalecendo o crescimento, a competitividade e a rentabilidade das marcas.

Suas Principais Atividades e Responsabilidades Serão

  • Conduzir análises estratégicas de desempenho do portfólio, identificando produtos de alta e baixa performance, oportunidades de crescimento, riscos de obsolescência e ações para maximização de resultados
  • Avaliar continuamente a saúde e a sustentabilidade do portfólio, recomendando estratégias de continuidade, renovação, racionalização e phase-out com base em indicadores de demanda, rentabilidade, giro e posicionamento de mercado
  • Monitorar os principais produtos ativos e suas evoluções ao longo do ciclo de vida, identificando oportunidades para potencializar vendas, margem, participação de mercado e eficiência do sortimento.
  • Gerar insights sobre best-sellers, long sellers e produtos de baixa relevância, transformando dados em recomendações estratégicas para gestão de categorias, coleções e portfólio
  • Estruturar recomendações para entrada, permanência, expansão ou descontinuação de produtos, assegurando um portfólio alinhado às necessidades do consumidor e aos objetivos de negócio.
  • Auxiliar na construção de briefings de desenvolvimento, fornecendo análises de mercado, análise histórica por canal, performance e oportunidades que suportem decisões de criação e evolução de produtos
  • Apoiar a definição da arquitetura e estrutura das coleções, contribuindo para a construção da pirâmide de produtos, representatividade de categorias, share de sortimento, profundidade de oferta e identificação de oportunidades de mercado
  • Desenvolver análises multidimensionais ao longo de todo o ciclo de vida do produto, avaliando desempenho em diferentes níveis de hierarquia (SKU, modelo, família, tema, categoria e subcategoria) para direcionar decisões estratégicas
  • Analisar a performance de produtos e categorias nos canais B2B e D2C, identificando comportamentos distintos, oportunidades de crescimento e estratégias de otimização por canal
  • Atuar como elo entre as áreas de Produto, Comercial, Planejamento, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, integração das informações e suporte à tomada de decisão de produto baseada em dados

  • Experiência prévia em análise de produto, merchandising, planejamento comercial ou gestão de categorias
  • Vivência com análise de indicadores de performance, incluindo vendas, sell-in, sell-out, margem, giro, cobertura e estoque
  • Experiência na construção de relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e análises para suporte à tomada de decisão
  • Domínio de Excel avançado e Power BI para análise de dados, modelagem e construção de relatórios e dashboards

Quem Somos e Qual o Nosso Propósito

Criada para abrigar marcas que atuam de forma independente umas das outras, a R.brands é uma house of brands, ou seja, uma casa de marcas que serve para abraçar diversas outras, cada uma com suas próprias características e DNA.

A nova identidade assume uma essência mais dinâmica, estratégica e conectada com o novo momento da empresa.

Como house of brands, nosso foco é desenvolver e gerir marcas de estilo de vida baseado em atividade, que conectem, inspirem e emocionem. Nosso propósito? Inspirar e habilitar pessoas a serem a melhor versão de si mesmas.

Nosso nome, R.brands, vem do termo evolution, que reúne em si referências à revolução que estamos construindo e à evolução que estamos vivenciando. Por aqui, uma grande transformação está acontecendo e o ponto presente no nosso nome não é um ponto final, mas sim um novo ponto de partida.

Atualmente, trabalhamos com 3 marcas: INVICTUS e BR FORCE, no segmento tático, e GALAPAGOS, no segmento outdoor. Cada uma delas possui objetivos específicos e personalidade própria, porém, são alinhadas ao propósito do grupo, permitindo, assim, uma atuação sinérgica e ampla.

Temos um ambiente voltado para alta performance, aprendizado, inovação e levamos muito a sério nossos valores: Integridade, Autorresponsabilidade, Obstinação, Inconformismo, Coragem e Empatia . Eles resumem como as coisas funcionam por aqui e, também, nosso jeito de ser. E aí, se identificou com a R.brands e se acha pronto para encarar esta revolução?

title: FF&E Supply chain Manager
description:
This position will work closely with Interior Designers and Senior FF&E Procurement Manager to maintain FF&E budgets, project procurement, supply chain, logistics and project installations.

We are seeking a highly organized and experienced FF&E Supply Chain Project Manager to oversee the full logistics, quality control, and delivery process for a luxury residential hospitality project in Brazil. This role is responsible for managing production follow-up, factory coordination, inbound logistics from multiple regions (Brazil and Europe), storage operations in Preá, and final‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara—an area with challenging access conditions.

The ideal candidate has strong project management skills, experience in complex supply‑chain environments, and the ability to work collaboratively with vendors, factories, construction teams, installers, and logistics partners.

At a Glance:

  1. Mid–Senior role overseeing end‑to‑end FF&E supply chain for a luxury hospitality project in Brazil
  2. Responsible for factory supervision, quality control, and production sign‑off (Brazil & Europe)
  3. Manages storage operations in Preá and all inbound logistics
  4. Coordinates last‑mile delivery into Jericoacoara with specialized 4x4/off‑road vehicles
  5. Oversees inventory accuracy, documentation, dispatch & receiving
  6. Plans and supervises loading/unloading, equipment rental, and batch delivery scheduling
  7. Works closely with Construction for delivery timelines, site readiness, and installation planning
  8. Supervises Utopia‑hired installers to ensure deadlines, quality standards, and contractual commitments
  9. Must be highly organized, proactive, and experienced in complex or remote logistics environments

Responsibilities

Production Oversight & Quality Control

  • Supervise FF&E production at each factory (Brazil & Europe).
  • Conduct detailed quality checks and approve inventory before packing and sign‑off.
  • Ensure all items meet Utopia’s standards for quality, specifications, and finishes.

Inbound Logistics & Storage Management

  • Monitor and confirm the arrival of goods at the Preá storage facility.
  • Arrange and oversee loading/unloading operations at all locations.
  • Hire necessary local equipment or machinery as required.
  • Maintain a full, accurate, and continuously updated inventory of all items.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Handle all dispatch, receiving, and transport paperwork.
  • Ensure complete documentation for internal controls and auditing.

Delivery Coordination & Final‑Mile Logistics

  • Oversee delivery schedules from factories to Preá, ensuring timely arrivals.
  • Plan and manage logistics from Preá to Jericoacoara—including batch deliveries due to access restrictions (large trucks cannot cross dunes).
  • Hire and coordinate appropriate 4x4 or off‑road trucks capable of operating in sandy conditions.
  • Supervise all loading/unloading operations for the Preá–Jericoacoara transfers.

On‑Site Coordination & Installation Support

  • Coordinate delivery timelines and equipment needs with the Construction team.
  • Organize and supervise unpacking activities.
  • Oversee Utopia‑hired installation teams to ensure full compliance with contract requirements, deadlines, and quality standards.

Professional Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in FF&E logistics, supply chain management, project management, or procurement—preferably in hospitality or high‑end residential projects.
  • Proven experience supervising factory production, performing quality checks, and managing sign‑off processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate international and domestic logistics (Brazil + Europe preferred).
  • Experience managing storage facilities, inventory systems, and warehouse operations.
  • Solid track record overseeing loading/unloading operations, equipment rental, and transport coordination.
  • Hands‑on experience with remote or difficult‑access job sites (desert, beach, island, jungle environments are a strong plus).
  • Experience coordinating with construction teams, installers, and multiple vendors simultaneously.
  • Prior responsibility for delivery scheduling, documentation, and compliance.
  • Experience supervising installation teams is highly desirable.
  • Portuguese and English a must - any other language a plus.

Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of FF&E manufacturing processes, materials, finishes, and quality standards.
  • Proficiency in inventory management tools, tracking systems, and documentation workflows.
  • Understanding of logistics planning, especially final‑mile or off‑road delivery constraints.
  • Familiarity with transport regulations, customs basics, and dispatch/receiving procedures.
  • Strong reporting and documentation skills (photos, checklists, receiving logs, QC reports).
  • Ability to read technical documents (spec sheets, shop drawings, BOQs).

Salary and benefits are competitive and based on candidate experience.

Note: Please submit your CV in English.

title: Coordenadora de Qualidade - Ford Tangará da Serra/MT
description:
O Master Performance (Coordenador de Qualidade e Experiência do Cliente) é responsável por garantir que a concessionária ofereça um atendimento de excelência, alinhado às expectativas e necessidades dos clientes. Este profissional monitora a qualidade dos serviços prestados, realiza a análise de feedback dos clientes e implementa ações corretivas e de melhoria contínua, visando otimizar a experiência do cliente em todas as etapas do processo pós-venda.

Objetivo do Cargo

  • Assegurar que a experiência do cliente seja elevada e de acordo com os indicadores da montadora e da concessionária.

Principais Responsabilidades:

1. Gestão da Qualidade

  • Estabelecer e acompanhar os padrões de qualidade dos serviços prestados na concessionária, garantindo que todos os processos, desde a recepção até a entrega do veículo, atendam aos requisitos de excelência.
  • Realizar auditorias periódicas nos serviços de pós-venda (oficina, lavagem, entrega de veículos) para verificar o cumprimento dos padrões estabelecidos.
  • Desenvolver e implementar procedimentos para melhoria contínua da qualidade, com foco na redução de falhas e aumento da eficiência operacional.

2. Monitoramento da Experiência do Cliente

  • Coletar e analisar feedbacks dos clientes por meio de pesquisas de satisfação, avaliações online, interações diretas e outros canais de comunicação.
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria na jornada do cliente, desde o agendamento de serviços até o pós-serviço, propondo e implementando soluções para aprimorar a experiência.
  • Acompanhar a evolução dos indicadores de satisfação e lealdade do cliente (NPS, RETENÇÃO, RECOMENDAÇÃO etc) e definir estratégias para melhorar esses índices.

3. Treinamento e Desenvolvimento da Equipe

  • Coordenar treinamentos e capacitações para as equipes de atendimento e de serviço, com foco na melhoria da experiência do cliente e no atendimento de qualidade.
  • Trabalhar junto aos líderes de equipe para garantir que todos os colaboradores compreendam a importância da qualidade no serviço e estejam alinhados com as expectativas da concessionária.
  • Fomentar uma cultura de atendimento ao cliente em toda a concessionária, garantindo que todos os colaboradores estejam engajados na entrega de uma experiência excepcional.

4. Gestão de Reclamações e Sugestões

  • Supervisionar e gerenciar o processo de tratamento de reclamações dos clientes, assegurando que todas sejam respondidas de forma eficaz e dentro do prazo estabelecido.
  • Implementar estratégias para resolver problemas de clientes insatisfeitos e transformar situações negativas em oportunidades de melhoria e fidelização.
  • Realizar reuniões periódicas com as equipes envolvidas para discutir reclamações e identificar ações corretivas que possam ser aplicadas.

5. Relacionamento com Clientes e Ações de Fidelização

  • Desenvolver ações de relacionamento e fidelização de clientes, visando aumentar a satisfação e a lealdade à concessionária.
  • Planejar e executar campanhas de pós-venda para engajar os clientes, como promoções de serviços, ofertas especiais e comunicação personalizada.
  • Ser o ponto de contato principal para clientes VIPs ou situações que exijam atenção especial.

Requisitos e Qualificações:

  • Escolaridade: Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em Administração, Gestão de Qualidade, Marketing ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Experiência prévia em áreas de qualidade, atendimento ao cliente ou gestão de processos em concessionárias ou empresas do setor automotivo.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos:
    • Técnicas de gestão de qualidade e melhoria contínua (ex: Kaizen, Six Sigma, 5S, 5W2H etc).
    • Ferramentas de coleta e análise de feedback de clientes (pesquisas de satisfação, NPS, RETENÇÃO, RECOMENDAÇÃO etc).
    • Processos de atendimento e experiência do cliente.
    • Conhecimento de ferramentas de CRM e gestão de relacionamento com clientes.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais:
    • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade para interagir com clientes e equipes.
    • Capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes focadas no atendimento e experiência do cliente.
    • Pensamento analítico e foco em resultados.
    • Proatividade para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e implementar mudanças eficazes.
    • Empatia, paciência e habilidade para resolver conflitos e situações desafiadoras.

Indicadores relacionados:

  • Índices de satisfação do cliente, como NPS, RETENÇÃO, RECOMENDAÇÃO, entre outros, com aumento contínuo.
  • Número de reclamações resolvidas de forma satisfatória e no menor tempo possível.
  • Eficiência na implementação de ações corretivas e de melhoria com base no feedback dos clientes.
  • Engajamento e capacitação das equipes para oferecer um atendimento de alta qualidade.
  • Fidelização de clientes e aumento do retorno de clientes para serviços de pós-venda.

Nossa cultura, O Jeito Agi

Viver pelo cliente
Nosso principal ativo são os clientes.A empresa só existe se conseguir resolver suas dores, entregando produtos e experiências melhores que alternativas disponíveis no mercado.

Agir como empreendedor Quantas empresas você conhece que cobram espírito de dono do time? Muitas, né? Mas quantas delas possibilitam que as pessoas sejam de fato donas? E não se trata de dar essa oportunidade para poucos, mas de tornar isso possível para todos. No Agibank é assim, então aqui você age como dono porque já é dono ou porque sonha em ser o próximo.

Crescer na jornada Nossa cultura é forte. Então, só faz sentido empreender aqui caso você se identifique muito com ela. Se você é uma pessoa fanática por resultado, tem pavor de zona de conforto, vive em eterna busca por conhecimento, prefere as coisas ditas direto ao ponto e quer estar rodeada de pessoas que também são assim, você vai curtir muito sua jornada aqui.

Perform quality assurance checks throughout the production process.

Experience in translation, localization, editorial production, publishing, or content quality assurance.

Strong understanding of grammar, style, and editorial best practices.

Experience using AI-powered writing, editing, or translation tools (such as ChatGPT, DeepL, Claude, Gemini, or similar).

Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

The specialist will primarily support Bloomberg's EMSX platform and trading workflows for equities and other listed instruments while developing expertise across adjacent electronic trading platforms, products, and workflows within Bloomberg’s Enterprise ecosystem.

  • Value collaboration, ownership, accountability, and operational excellence

You’ll Need to Have

  • Experience in financial services, electronic trading, trade support, fintech, broker‑dealer operations, production support, or workflow management environments
